title: Corpus statistics meet the noun compound
limitations: English noun compounds; the abstract does not validate transfer to Chinese or reader friction
notes: Abstract reports that conceptual association broadens coverage and a dependency model outperforms a deepest-constituent model

title: Multiword noun compound bracketing using Wikipedia
limitations: English multiword noun compounds and Wikipedia; its reported performance is not evidence for Chinese technical prose
notes: Abstract combines lexical relational and coordinate evidence and uses encyclopedic term and named-entity coverage

title: Using the Web as an Implicit Training Set: Application to Noun Compound Syntax and Semantics
limitations: English noun compounds; web-count and search-interface behavior may not be reproducible over time
notes: Abstract separates structural bracketing from hidden semantic-relation paraphrases and uses surface corpus evidence

title: A Dataset for Joint Noun-Noun Compound Bracketing and Interpretation
limitations: English noun-noun compounds and an existing gold standard cannot serve as Chinese validation
notes: Abstract treats syntactic bracketing and semantic relations as linked but distinct analysis targets

title: Mandarin Chinese compounds, their representation, and processing in the visual modality
limitations: Review-level evidence; does not operationalize the present long modifier sequence or intervention
notes: Abstract concludes that the word rather than the morpheme is the basic representation unit and reviews factors affecting Mandarin compound access

title: Processing Mandarin Chinese Compound Words by Native Speakers and Second Language Learners: Word Frequency, Semantic Transparency, and Word Structure
authors_or_organization: Yuxin Hao; Chenxi Wu; Xun Duan
limitations: Compound-word recognition is narrower than long technical modifier sequences and the abstract alone does not establish a refinement target
notes: Abstract reports effects involving word frequency semantic transparency and word structure
